## Summary

`Sampler._requires_logits_processing()` runs on every sampling step and currently scans multiple per-request NumPy/Python states. This change computes the combined predicate in `add_request()` and stores one boolean per request slot, so the hot-path gate only scans the active rows of one compact array.

title: [ROCm] fix sleep mode not releasing GPU memory problem on ROCm
body:
## Purpose
On ROCm, `hipMemRelease` does not return physical VRAM to the free pool
while the virtual-address reservation (from `hipMemAddressReserve`) is still
held. This causes sleep mode to report memory as freed at the HIP runtime
level, but the GPU VRAM remains occupied at the hardware level (confirmed via
`rocm-smi`), preventing other applications (e.g. RL training frameworks) from
using the freed memory.

at the end of `unmap_and_release` on the ROCm path. This forces the driver to
actually release the physical pages while immediately re-reserving the same
virtual address so that a subsequent `create_and_map` (wake_up) works without
changing any tensor pointers.

## Motivation

In Wan Video's cross-attention layers, the KV tensors are derived from text encoder (512 tokens) or image encoder (257 tokens) outputs, which are identical (replicated) across all sequence-parallel ranks. The existing code unnecessarily applies the full USP pipeline to these replicated tensors:
